title: Fair Trade
summary: On Day twelve, a stranger offers a trade Sam cannot refuse.

beats.text: Marek opened the cupboard. Under his arm, wriggling, was Biscuit.
"Fair trade," he said. "The key for the dog."
Mrs. Okafor stepped forward. "Put him down, young man."
beats.speaker: okafor

beats.text: Biscuit whined. At the far end, a slow shape turned toward the sound.
Outside, more of them turned toward the whimper.
I handed over the roof key. It was the only thing we owned.
"The dog walks with me," Marek said. "Insurance."
He slipped into the rain. Biscuit's face stared back through the glass.
Leo cried. Dara held him. I could not breathe.
Then Mr. Hale opened his fist. "That key only opens the roof, Sam. The tug starts with this one."
beats.speaker: hale
